messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 19):
"""
5.3 Whether the proposal form proposed to be used for this product is already filed Yes / No 5.4 If Yes, furnish the Unique Reference Number of the Proposal Form 5.5 If No, attach the proposal form afresh as per the applicable provisions of Product Filing procedure. Section VI - Distribution Channels 6 Distribution channels: 6.1 Specify the various distribution channels to be used for distributing the product- [reply shall be specific and cannot refer to the replies like “as approved by IRDAI”] 6.1 Commission scales to distribution channels— specify the rates which are to be paid-[reply shall be specific] S No Item Particulars (to be filled in by insurer) 6.2 Expected proportions of business to be procured by each channel shall be indicated for the next 5 years.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"If a health insurance product has not yet been filed, what must the insurer attach to the application?","answer":"The insurer must attach a fresh proposal form as per the applicable provisions of the Product Filing procedure.","facts":["5.5 If No, attach the proposal form afresh as per the applicable provisions of Product Filing procedure"]},{"question":"What information must be specified regarding distribution channels in the product filing?","answer":"The insurer must specify the various distribution channels, the commission scales to be paid to each channel, and the expected proportions of business to be procured by each channel for the next five years.","facts":["6.1 Specify the various distribution channels to be used for distributing the product","6.1 Commission scales to distribution channels— specify the rates which are to be paid","6.2 Expected proportions of business to be procured by each channel shall be indicated for the next 5 years"]}]}
